title: Multi-target hyperbolic sieves and elliptic trace obstructions
summary: Let $N=pq$ be a product of two primes, and let $\ell$ be an odd prime not dividing $N$. For $a\in\mathbb F_\ell^*$, the set \[ H_a(N;\ell)=\{ax+Nx^{-1}:x\in\mathbb F_\ell^*\} \] contains the residue of $ap+q$ modulo $\ell$. Since residues outside this set can be excluded when searching for that linear form, it has been applied as a sieve for linear combinations of $p$ and $q$ in recent deterministic integer factorization methods. Its size is $(\ell+χ(aN))/2$, where $χ$ is the Legendre symbol modulo $\ell$. We study unions of these sets, which give a common set of candidate residues for…
